beats.title: A bank, and the four tools that run it
beats.say: Everything here is simulated: 400 applications, and the systems its IT teams use every day.

beats.title: A normal afternoon
beats.say: Logs flow in and nothing is wrong. The agent is learning what normal looks like.

beats.title: A routine change ships
beats.say: Changes go to production all day. One of them is about to break something.

beats.title: Errors appear
beats.say: Within seconds the agent notices the spike and opens a case. No alert has fired yet.

beats.title: Then the alerts start
beats.say: Each alert is on a different application. This is when people would start getting paged.

beats.title: One problem, not dozens
beats.say: 8 applications are failing. The agent works out they are the same problem and keeps one case.

beats.title: How bad is it?
beats.say: Gemini reads the logs and the application catalog, and sizes it up.

beats.title: It opens the parent incident
beats.say: Priority is set, and it goes straight to the team that owns the suspect application.

beats.title: Every affected system is on the record
beats.say: The incident lists all 36 applications it touches, not just the one it is filed against.

beats.title: Tickets about the same problem are grouped under it
beats.say: Branch staff called the help desk about this too. Their 3 tickets now sit under this one incident.

beats.title: One chat, with the right people in it
beats.say: Named for the incident, with 8 people added. Each is told why they are there.

beats.title: And briefs them
beats.say: One message: impact, timeline, the leading suspect and links to the evidence.

beats.title: It turns the chat into a call
beats.say: Everyone is prompted to join. Recording, transcription and the Facilitator are already on.

beats.title: It finds the cause
beats.say: It checks GitLab for recent changes, rules out the ones that do not fit, names the one responsible and suggests a fix.

beats.title: This is the change
beats.say: It passed review, and the service it changed never returned an error itself.

beats.title: It writes the fix
beats.say: A merge request with the fix, explaining the cause and the evidence.

beats.title: Your turn: merge it
beats.say: This decision stays with a person. The agent cannot merge, on purpose.

beats.title: Merged
beats.say: This decision stays with a person. The agent cannot merge, on purpose.

beats.title: It creates the change request and links it in the chat
beats.say: The emergency change request is in ServiceNow. The link goes in the chat, so someone can review it and edit it.

beats.title: The change request, open to review and edit
beats.say: Raised by the agent with the fix, the reason and the back-out plan filled in. A person can change any of it.

beats.title: Then checks it actually worked
beats.say: Errors on the affected applications: 986 a minute before the fix, 143 now.

beats.title: All clear
beats.say: The agent tells the chat it is fixed. Now the paperwork, which it also does.

beats.title: It fills out the incident
beats.say: The Resolution section: cause code, the change that caused it, the change that fixed it, the outage window and the impact.

beats.title: It opens the problem record
beats.say: What happened, why, and what stops a repeat. It is already on the agenda for tomorrow's 8 AM problem stand-up.

beats.title: First error to fixed
beats.say: The agent did the legwork. A person made the one decision that mattered.
